title: Q-SPEC-12-stem-matching: Stem matching for anchors in the signal pipeline
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:git grep -q "export function stem" -- workers/core/signals/index.js
**Status:** closed

US-SPEC-12 section 6 lists the failure 'whole-word match fails on word stems' with the mitigation 'stem matching', and its status section lists it PLANNED. workers/core/signals/index.js matches an artifact's assertions by normalized substring only (`norm(content).includes(norm(assertion))` in `synthesize` and `revise`), so an assertion restated with another word form (reduces, reduced) reads as removed and is logged as narrowing. Add a small suffix stemmer (`stem`), compare assertions token by token on stems, keep the exact-substring result as the first test, and add a case to workers/core/signals/signals.test.js where a re-inflected assertion is kept and a dropped one is still narrowing.

size: S
**Out of scope:** language detection, a model call, any change to the strict-shrink rule (US-12-R07).

Prediction: spec_quality >= 0.9 within 336 h

**Closing probe:** cmd:git grep -q "stem" -- workers/core/signals/signals.test.js and the status row of US-SPEC-12 for stem matching reads BUILT with the file and its test.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T14:19:27Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
